h: Orji Kalu visits Governor Otti, faces backlash over road comment
p: Senator Orji Uzor Kalu has shared photos from a visit to Abia Governor Alex Otti, praising him for road projects. Some social media users criticised him for also mentioning a road he built as governor.
body: Former Abia State governor and senator Orji Uzor Kalu has drawn mixed reactions after sharing photos from a private visit to Governor Alex Otti.

Kalu said in a post on Friday, 20 November 2026, that he met the governor at his residence on Thursday. He said he commended Otti for rebuilding the Uzuakoli-Abiriba-Ohafia road and an internal road in his Igbere community.
He also recalled that he had built the same internal road during his time as governor more than 20 years ago, adding that development is a continuous process.
Some social media users criticised Kalu for mentioning the road he built during his time as governor.
more: Kalu praised Otti for road projects.
He said he built one of the roads as governor.
